params.body:
Ilse's mail of 2026-09-17 17:01 ("Issues Stocklist Dealer") was implemented today in #541, #542, #543, #544 and #546. Those rules cited `klant:beslissingen#lijsten-2026-09-17`, the anchor of the morning list, because the decisions file was being split (#545) at the time.

This adds the mail as its own decision file, `bronnen/beslissingen/2026-09-17-issues-mail-17u.md` (the questions quoted, plus Shane's choices on the open points: showroom toggle independent of the website integration, bidding sort as a per-user preference, API-created vehicle without VIN opens on Type, lookup fills empty fields only), and repoints the nine rules (R S1-2.19, S1-9.24, S2-5.23, S2-7.17, S3-3.9, S3-7.1, S3-7.6, B1-2.9, P3-2.11) to it.

`bin/rules-sources`: 874 rules, no problems (105 client-sourced, up from 97).
params.title: Business rules: Ilse's third list of 17 September as its own decision file
